messages:
Mike: Quick sync - Helix wants to swap CompetitorX -> Redwood for prod. They ran a smoke and see response deltas, tokenization truncation, and a few security asks. They want a short POC, pricing for both Hosted and Dedicated, and answers for the security questionnaire.
Anya: Can we get 3-4 example prompts that diverged? even brief ones let us reproduce.
Mike: Pasted their top three: 
```
- 'Summarize the following policy (2k chars) in 6 bullets'
- 'Write a formal customer-facing status update with action items and owner names'
- 'Convert this bulleted requirements list into an acceptance criteria table'
```
Priya: Security Qs they called out: KMS key control, log retention/audit, data residency, SOC2/ISO attestation. They asked if PII is stored during Hosted POC.
Sam: Tech note - likely causes: tokenization mismatch -> off-by-one truncation; role handling (assistant/system vs competitor roles); and small sampling noise. We can mitigate with:
- canonicalize inputs (normalize unicode, explicit EOS token)
- map competitor role fields to Redwood messages array
- run deterministic sampling for POC (temp=0) to reduce variance
Anya: Good. Request: ask Helix for an eval set (~30 prompts) + acceptability criteria (auto score threshold or manual pass rate). We'll run our eval harness and produce a diff spreadsheet.
Eli: On billing, recommend: 14 days free Hosted credits up to 250k tokens + a convert incentive (10% off Dedicated first 90 days) if they commit within 30 days. Finance needs final ok.
Mike: I'll propose that. Priya, can you prepare our standard security pack and highlight Private deployment (customer-managed KMS) and Dedicated (network isolation)?
Priya: Yep - sending security pack + short SOC/ISO summary. I'll note we do not persist customer prompt content in plaintext for Dedicated/Private; Hosted POC will have short-term logs but we can limit retention.
Sam: I'll draft a minimal shim mapping example and a normalization checklist. Sample mapping below:
```json
{"competitor_payload": {"text":"...","role":"user"}, "redwood_payload": {"messages": [{"role":"user","content":"..."}], "max_tokens": 1024}}
```
Anya: Can we spin up a parity test endpoint with a compatibility model and retention 7d to run the harness?
deploy-bot: created endpoint helix-compat-test-1734 (model=rwd-compat-3.1, retention=7d)
Mike: Action items: 1) Mike -> ask Helix for eval set + acceptance rules (today) 2) Anya -> run eval harness against helix-compat-test-1734 and share diff sheet (tomorrow) 3) Priya -> send security pack & KMS options (EOD) 4) Eli -> confirm credit + draft POC quote (today)
Eli: I'll draft the quote and loop in finance. If Helix needs Dedicated early, we'll provide an estimated month-to-month rate for sizing.
Mike: I'll ping the Helix account team and ask for the eval set and their security contact. Post the eval here when received. :thumbsup:
